legsA.name: Legs A
legsA.warmup: Stepmill 8 min easy, then 2–3 ramp sets on the pendulum squat.

ex.name: Pendulum Squat
ex.cue: Feet low and narrow. Three seconds down, no bounce out of the hole.

ex.name: Romanian Deadlift
ex.cue: Stop two reps short. Never take a hinge to failure.

ex.name: Leg Extension
ex.cue: Myo-reps on set 2: to failure, rest 15 sec, 4 reps, repeat three times.

ex.name: Seated Leg Curl
ex.cue: Lengthened partials after failure on set 2.

ex.name: Standing Calf Raise
ex.cue: Two-second pause at the bottom of every rep.

ex.name: Bench Press
ex.cue: Set 1 at 2 reps in reserve, set 2 at 0–1. No singles, no doubles.

ex.name: Incline DB Press
ex.cue: Per hand.

ex.name: Cable Fly
ex.cue: Per side. Own the bottom, don't rush it.

ex.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
ex.cue: Per hand.

ex.name: Lateral Raise
ex.cue: Per hand. Cheat the last few up, lower them slow.

ex.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
ex.cue: Last, not first. Fresh triceps are what let you press 80.

ex.name: Cable Crunch
ex.cue: Round the spine, don't hip-hinge it.

pullA.name: Pull A
pullA.warmup: Ramp to your working weight — the 20 kg and 40 kg sets are warm-ups, not sets.

ex.name: Plate Loaded Row
ex.cue: First, while you're fresh. Both work sets at the same load.

ex.name: Cable Lat Pulldown
ex.cue: Chest up, drive elbows to the floor.

ex.name: Seated Cable Row, narrow
ex.cue: Pause a beat at the sternum.

ex.name: Reverse Pec Deck
ex.cue: Rear delts. Light and high rep — don't chase load here.

ex.name: Cable Shrug
ex.cue: Off chest day, and actually loaded now.

ex.name: Cable Biceps Curl
ex.cue: Cut from three sets — the pulls already do plenty.

legsB.name: Legs B
legsB.warmup: Stepmill 8 min, then two ramp sets on the leg curl.

ex.name: Seated Leg Curl
ex.cue: Heavy while you're fresh — the mirror of Monday, where it ran fourth.

ex.name: Pendulum Squat
ex.cue: Feet mid-platform, shoulder width. Lighter and higher rep than Monday on purpose.

ex.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
ex.cue: Per hand, per leg. First unilateral work in the program.

ex.name: Leg Extension
ex.cue: Drop set on set 2: to failure, strip 30%, straight back to failure.

ex.name: Lying Leg Curl
ex.cue: Hip extended instead of flexed — hits the hamstring differently to the seated version.

ex.name: Standing Calf Raise
ex.cue: Lighter, higher rep than Monday. Still pause the bottom.

ex.name: Incline Barbell Press
ex.cue: The lighter of your two press days — deliberately. Twice-weekly heavy benching is what breaks shoulders.

ex.name: Flat DB Press
ex.cue: Per hand.

ex.name: Pec Deck
ex.cue: Lengthened partials after failure on set 2.

ex.name: Lateral Raise
ex.cue: Per hand.

ex.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Ext
ex.cue: Overhead hits the long head — Tuesday's pushdowns don't.

pullB.name: Pull B
pullB.warmup: Two light lat pulldown sets to get the shoulders moving before you hang.

ex.name: Reverse-Grip Pull-Up
ex.cue: Bodyweight — log added weight only. Add weight once you clear 10.

ex.name: Single-Arm Cable Lat Pulldown
ex.cue: Per side. Let the shoulder travel all the way up at the top.

ex.name: Seated Cable Row
ex.cue: Wider grip than Wednesday's — different angle, same muscle.

ex.name: Straight-Arm Rope Pulldown
ex.cue: Cut from three sets and moved off the front of the session.

ex.name: Reverse Pec Deck
ex.cue: Second rear-delt hit of the week.

ex.name: Hammer Curl
ex.cue: Per hand. Off chest day, onto the day your biceps are already working.
